breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflict between using a "gamma-centered" k-point grid and a "Monkhorst-Pack grid with a half shift", as these are mutually exclusive. The ground truth resolved this by only keeping the "gamma-centered" instruction. The agent, however, included both contradictory statements in its output, thus failing to fix the inconsistency.
